name: M-C Fabrication Inc
old_description: With a multitude of welding and assembly processes we can take on jobs, large and small.  Our 30 Ton capacity facility offers Mig and Tig welding, that includes various grades of steel, stainless steel and aluminum.
about:
M-C Fabrication Inc operates from Olathe, Kansas, on the southwest side of the Kansas City metropolitan area. The company was founded in 1976 as a millwright and conveyor fabricator, and has since grown into a fully integrated metal fabrication shop.

The 100,000-square-foot facility on more than eight acres houses a range of capabilities including MIG and TIG welding, custom metal sawing with automated bandsaws and a NISHIJMAX cold cut saw, press brake forming and rolling on two Amada brakes, hi-def plasma cutting on plates up to 8 by 14 feet, precision laser cutting with dual interchangeable tables, CNC machining on six vertical mills and horizontal lathes, iron working, and finishing services such as wet painting, powder coating, zinc plating, and galvanizing. The shop employs 37 certified welders and two on-site programmers, and handles material from 20-gauge sheet metal up to 2-inch plate.

M-C Fabrication serves customers globally, producing heavy components, large weldments, and small assemblies used around the world. While the company does not list specific industry sectors, its focus on heavy fabrication suggests clients in industrial equipment, structural steel, and machinery manufacturing.

The company emphasizes its integrated in-house capacity—from design and programming through cutting, forming, machining, welding, and finishing—as a differentiator that allows it to tackle large, complex jobs with an average lead time of four to six weeks.
